name: The copy relation is an equivalence
description: Exercise 4.84: the copy relation among systems is reflexive, symmetric and transitive.

elements.text: Every system is a copy of itself.
If Z1 is a copy of Z2 and Z2 is a copy of Z3, then Z1 is a copy of Z3.
If Z1 is a copy of Z2, then Z2 is a copy of Z1.
Identity isomorphism with identity port maps.
Compose the isomorphisms and the port families.
By Theorem 4.45 each port map is bijective, so the inverse isomorphism is again port-preserving.
